INSERT INTO nomina_revision_operativa(periodo_id,nomina_empleado_id,persona_id,vinculacion_id,estado_revision,invalidado_at,motivo_invalidacion,updated_at)
  VALUES(v_periodo,v_empleado,v_persona,v_vinculacion,$19,NOW(),v_reason,NOW())
  ON CONFLICT(periodo_id,nomina_empleado_id) DO UPDATE SET estado_revision=$20,revisado_por=$21,revisado_at=$22,
    invalidado_at=NOW(),motivo_invalidacion=v_reason,version_revision=nomina_revision_operativa.version_revision+$23,updated_at=NOW()

UPDATE nomina_movimientos SET cantidad=$2,valor_calculado=$3,valor_total=$4,updated_by=$1,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$5 AND cantidad=$6 AND valor_total=$7 AND estado=$8 AND afecta_seguridad_social=$9 RETURNING id
SELECT current_setting($1) AS isolation,pg_try_advisory_xact_lock($2,$3) AS locked
SELECT $2 FROM ONLY "public"."usuarios" x WHERE "id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x

SELECT ne.vinculacion_id,v.persona_id                              FROM nomina_empleados ne
    JOIN vinculaciones v ON v.id=ne.vinculacion_id WHERE ne.id=v_empleado LIMIT $16

INSERT INTO auditoria(usuario_id,tabla_afectada,registro_id,accion,descripcion,datos_anteriores,datos_nuevos) SELECT usuario_id,tabla_afectada,registro_id,accion,descripcion,datos_anteriores,datos_nuevos FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(usuario_id bigint,tabla_afectada text,registro_id bigint,accion text,descripcion text,datos_anteriores jsonb,datos_nuevos jsonb) RETURNING to_jsonb(auditoria.*) AS row
SELECT $2 FROM ONLY "public"."contratos" x WHERE "id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x

INSERT INTO historial_cambios(usuario_id,tabla_afectada,registro_id,campo,valor_anterior,valor_nuevo,motivo) SELECT usuario_id,tabla_afectada,registro_id,campo,valor_anterior,valor_nuevo,motivo FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(usuario_id bigint,tabla_afectada text,registro_id bigint,campo text,valor_anterior text,valor_nuevo text,motivo text) RETURNING to_jsonb(historial_cambios.*) AS row

SELECT c.relname AS table_name,t.tgname FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$2 AND c.relname=ANY($1::text[]) AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname

WITH m AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT id FROM nomina_movimientos WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE),d AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT id FROM cobertura_cuenta_cobro_externa_detalle WHERE id=$2 FOR UPDATE),c AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT id FROM cobertura_cuentas_cobro_externas WHERE id=$3 FOR UPDATE),r AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT id FROM nomina_revision_operativa WHERE id=$4 FOR UPDATE) SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM m) AS m,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM d) AS d,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM c) AS c,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM r) AS r
